newsitem.title: ESTONIA: UHIS CONSOLIDATES PEP ON MAY 26.
newsitem.headline: UHIS CONSOLIDATES PEP ON MAY 26.

text.p: Uhispank will consolidate Pohja-Eesti Pank (PEP) into its balance sheet on May 26, Uhispank shareholders decided.

"The banks have essentially already been merged as the last branch was merged with Uhispank last Friday," vice president Janek Maggi told Reuters after a shareholder meeting decided on Saturday on the dates of the consolidation.
Uhispank share capital will increase by 50 million kroons to 285 million kroons after the consolidation. Pohja-Eesti Pank shares are held by Uhispank subsidiary Uhisinvesteeringud now.
The merger process also needs the approval of the central bank, Maggi added.
Uhispank shareholders also decided to transfer its last year profit of 57.4 million kroons to reserves and issue stock dividends, one share for every 20.
The bank will pay the stock dividends in May.
